Continuous Improvement Coordinator
Tamar Valley Test Manufacturing Pty Ltd (fictional employer for system testing)
Location: Launceston, Tasmania (on site, Monday to Friday, 38 hours per week)
Employment type: Full time, permanent
Closing date: 30 November 2026, 11:59pm AEDT

About the role
We are a mid-sized food packaging manufacturer. The Continuous Improvement Coordinator works with the
Operations Manager to find and remove waste on our packing lines, improve how work is planned and
recorded, and help supervisors use data to make decisions.

Key responsibilities
- Map current processes and identify improvement opportunities with supervisors and operators.
- Build and maintain Excel-based reports and simple dashboards on output, downtime and waste.
- Coordinate small improvement projects from idea to implementation and report progress to management.
- Document standard work procedures and train staff in new ways of working.
- Support stock and ordering accuracy by checking data against physical counts.

Essential criteria
- A degree in industrial engineering, operations management or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience improving a business process and measuring the result.
- Strong Excel skills, including building reports used by others.
- Clear written and verbal communication with staff at all levels.

Desirable criteria
- Experience with Power BI or a similar reporting tool.
- Exposure to Lean or Six Sigma methods.
- Experience in a manufacturing or warehouse environment.

Requirements
- Australian working rights.
- Current Australian driver licence.

How to apply
Please submit a CV and a cover letter (maximum one page) through our careers page.
